**Status**: COMPLETE

## Executive Summary

Successfully optimized the feeds list query to eliminate N+1 database queries. Created a PostgreSQL view `feeds_with_latest_episode` that pre-joins the latest episode data for each feed, reducing query count from N+1 to 1 (where N = number of feeds).

**Key Metrics**:
- Query reduction: N+1 to 1 (with 57 feeds: 58 queries reduced to 1)
- Files created: 1 (Alembic migration)
- Files modified: 2 (supabase.ts, version.ts)
- Version: v2.34

## What Was Accomplished

**Database Layer** (1 file):
- `/Users/paulbrown/Desktop/coding-projects/podcast/alembic/versions/3cb98f7a9984_add_feeds_with_latest_episode_view.py`
  - Created PostgreSQL view using LATERAL JOIN for efficient O(1) latest episode lookup
  - View includes all feed columns plus `latest_episode_title` and `last_episode_date`
  - Follows existing RLS patterns (view inherits from underlying tables)

**Web UI** (2 files):
- `/Users/paulbrown/Desktop/coding-projects/podcast/web_ui_hosted/utils/supabase.ts`
  - Updated `getFeeds()` method to query the new view instead of N+1 loop
  - Reduced from 35 lines to 16 lines of code
- `/Users/paulbrown/Desktop/coding-projects/podcast/web_ui_hosted/app/version.ts`
  - Incremented version from 2.33 to 2.34
